title.zh: 修订第602号共和国法第3条（A）项（经第4180号共和国法修正），将采矿企业雇员纳入该法适用范围的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Section Three (A) of Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred Two, as Amended by Republic Act Numbered Four Thousand One Hundred Eighty, so as to Include Employees of Mining Enterprises Within the Purview of Said Act
title.orig: An Act Amending Section Three (A) of Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred Two, as Amended by Republic Act Numbered Four Thousand One Hundred Eighty, so as to Include Employees of Mining Enterprises Within the Purview of Said Act

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4707_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section three (a) of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred two, as amended by Republic Act Numbered Four thousand one hundred eighty, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 3. Minimum Wage. (a) Every employer shall pay to each of his employees who is employed by an enterprise other than in agriculture minimum wages of not less than six pesos a day: Provided , That this Act shall not apply to any retail or service enterprise that regularly employs not more than five employees;"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1966
